ownership: Piano owns completion thresholds, sticky engagement/completion, legacy counter migration, record keys, projections, summaries and logging. Platform owns only per-user app directory resolution and YAML read/write/mtime.
compatibility: Installed composition continues injecting the same actual Piano class into School with its existing app/filename options. School's legacy completion fields and Piano threshold/config reads are preserved; its persistence is not simplified during this migration.

baseline.population: 16 original store cases, 3 original School cases plus 1 legacy-record guard, and 4 original Piano economy-hook cases
